class_name: 起点-極端例-ヲハジメトシテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: Names the leading or most representative member of a set and implies that the rest of the set follows, so the noun it marks should genuinely rank first in prominence — headline city, head of the organization, flagship product. Register is written and ceremonial (speeches, news copy, company announcements); をはじめとしまして is the polite variant and the clipped をはじめ is by far the most common shape in ordinary speech and writing. Sibling など merely offers a sample and can sound offhand, whereas をはじめとして explicitly ranks.

examples.ruby: 校長[こうちょう]をはじめとして、先生[せんせい]方[がた]が壇上[だんじょう]に並[なら]んだ。
examples.english: Led by the principal, the teachers lined up on the stage.

examples.ruby: 京都[きょうと]をはじめとする古都[こと]には、外国[がいこく]からの客[きゃく]が多[おお]い。
examples.english: The ancient capitals, Kyoto foremost among them, draw many visitors from abroad.

examples.ruby: 小麦[こむぎ]をはじめ、輸入[ゆにゅう]品[ひん]の値段[ねだん]が上[あ]がり続[つづ]けている。
examples.english: Starting with wheat, the prices of imported goods just keep climbing.

patterns.usage_note: Offers a non-exhaustive sample rather than a ranked one: the item named is representative, and the listener is meant to infer that comparable things belong too. It attaches to nouns, to dictionary-form verbs and i-adjectives, and to だ/た, and it also does duty as a softener — 私[わたし]などには and お茶[ちゃ]などいかがですか lower the profile of what is named, out of modesty or politeness, and with a negative predicate it turns dismissive (謝[あやま]る気[き]など ない). なんか and なんて are its colloquial descendants, the first casual, the second coloured by surprise or scorn.

examples.ruby: 休[やす]みの日[ひ]はパンやジャムなどを買[か]いに行[い]く。
examples.english: On my days off I go out for bread, jam, that sort of thing.

examples.ruby: 週末[しゅうまつ]は本[ほん]を読[よ]むなどして静[しず]かに過[す]ごした。
examples.english: I spent a quiet weekend reading and the like.

examples.ruby: 頭痛[ずつう]やめまいなどの症状[しょうじょう]が続[つづ]いている。
examples.english: Symptoms such as headaches and dizziness have been persisting.
